proof_scope: Real thin skill wrapper delegating to the canonical project CLI. Synthetic inputs, real file effects; no copied implementation or mocked services.

claims.proves: The wrapper executes four-format anonymization and explicit fuzzy-policy review while preserving input, approval, privacy, installation and filesystem boundaries.
claims.does_not_prove: Human identity adjudication, general PII discovery, production scale, old trial qualification covering the extension, or Google Meet/screen sharing.
